description: ANThology's Renovate config. Everything shared lives in the preset at ANTfrastructure's repository root (default.json); the `extends` line below is the whole adoption, exactly as in the other consumers.

WHAT THIS REPO GETS IS DIFFERENT FROM THE OTHERS, and it is worth stating so nobody looks for the wrong thing. ANThology has NO ANTfrastructure submodule -- its workflows check the tooling out in CI -- so the preset's git-submodules manager, which is the headline everywhere else, has no gitlink to watch here. What it does buy: helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests over the third-party actions this repo references by tag, and the preset rule that deliberately leaves the Kataglyphis/ANTfrastructure composite actions at @main for the upstream-first change flow.

That second rule matters here more than in any other repo: docs.yml checks ANTfrastructure out at a floating `ref: main` rather than a pin, so the actions and the tooling must be allowed to move together.
.github/dependabot.yml is deliberately still present; it covers the pub ecosystem. The hand-over is a separate decision.

Renovate resolves `github>Kataglyphis/ANTfrastructure` from ANTfrastructure's DEFAULT BRANCH. The Renovate GitHub App is NOT installed on this repository and will not be (owner decision, 2026-09-09) -- no bot will ever author a commit here. That does not make this file idle: the local CLI reads exactly it. See https://github.com/Kataglyphis/ANTfrastructure/blob/main/docs/dependency-updates.md.
